findingDetails.title: The background-refresh disable switch fails open on any value other than off
OLLAMA_BASE_URL is forwarded and used without a loopback check, so the shared daemon ships the whole corpus to whatever host the first caller names

results.summary: The env reference documents off as the only disable value and the code matches it exactly; the reference does not say whether a non-loopback OLLAMA_BASE_URL is supported.
The review target is a file list, not a spec folder, so there is no checklist.md.

noveltyJustification: Two new P2 findings against six carried findings: the fail-open disable switch and the unvalidated Ollama destination are both new security directions, and neither repeats a correctness direction.

title: The background-refresh disable switch fails open on any value other than off
OLLAMA_BASE_URL is forwarded and used without a loopback check, so the shared daemon ships the whole corpus to whatever host the first caller names

detail: security: 2 P2 (fail-open disable switch, unvalidated Ollama destination); the allowlist, the DB-dir pin, the generation resolver and the heartbeat grace are clean

direction: The launcher can be made to forward an arbitrary ambient variable
reason: the filter is CHILD_ENV_ALLOWLIST.has(key) with exact keys only (system-skill-advisor-launcher.cjs:320)

direction: The generation counter can be redirected outside the workspace without an explicit override
reason: the anchored resolver joins the repo root with a fixed relative path (generation.ts:70)

direction: The watchdog can kill a healthy daemon during a slow startup refresh
reason: the heartbeat is written before the refresh is fired (liveness.ts:136, advisor-server.ts:391)

direction: The stress workflow can embed against a live Ollama
reason: it sets the exact off value the check accepts (skill-advisor-stress.yml:49)
